title: 第15章 引狼，杀三人
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
这事由不得孙友成犹豫。

    他就是在大胆，也不敢在朝廷的春税上动脑筋。

    一旦被人查出来，那是全家掉脑袋的事。

    眼见大哥犹豫，孙友文持续加码。

    “大哥，我现在就只差这临门一脚了，若是能成，咱们家就是白杨镇上最显赫的家族。”

    “到时候你也不用待在这破村子里，我带你去县城转转，那里光是青楼就有三座，还有其他吃的喝的玩的，保管你乐不思蜀。”

    “而且，一旦我能入品，咱家在这白杨镇就是如土皇帝一般的存在，便是那号称百年世家的孔家，也要看咱们的脸色行事。”

    “大哥，是功成名就，还是默默无闻，就在这一遭了，你可要早下决断啊。”

    不得不说。

    孙友文描绘的场景，很让人心动。

    “友文，这事，老爹知道吗？”

    “当然知道，这个办法还是老爹给我出的。”

    孙友文回答的极其坦然。

    可正在低头思索的孙友成，却没有发现弟弟那闪烁的目光。

    “好！”

    孙友成一咬牙，“既然老爹知晓，那哥哥这一颗脑袋，就交到你手上了。”

    “大哥，不必这般郑重，明天一切都会很顺利的，你就等着成为白杨镇第一纨绔大少吧，哈哈哈！”

    孙友文抱了抱大哥。

    两人又继续商议明日行动的一些细节。

    需要带多少护卫，若是有村民跟随一起该如何，以及孙友文的埋伏地点。

    聊到激烈的时候，兄弟两个激动不已。

    也让孙友成忘记了派上山的孙志刚三人。

    ……

    天色渐渐黑了。

    太阳在人间，洒下最后一丝余光。

    天边的云，被映衬出炫目的红色。

    诗情画意，在这一刻涌上陆林的心头。

    “夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏。”

    吟诗半首，陆林继续出发。

    等他快来到山口时，隐约发现前面有人影晃动。

    陆大勇说过，山里遇到什么都有可能，但千万不要贸然上去打招呼。

    遇到野兽，大不了就是你死我活。

    可若是遇到心思歹毒的人，那会让人生不如死。

    陆林谨记。

    只是，人影之中，有一道影子陆林颇为熟悉，看起来有些像陆杨。

    陆杨？

    这家伙不是腿断了，跑山里来做什么。

    陆林心头疑惑。

    陆林将背上的冬鹿放下，背着弓小心靠近。

    距离几人还有五十步的时候，陆林听到了陆杨的声音。

    “特娘的，冻死老子了，陆林这个王八蛋该不会死在山里了吧。”

    “陆杨你急什么，你就这么迫不及待想要杀死自己的亲弟弟？”

    孙志刚玩味笑问。

    “那当然，就是因为他是我亲弟弟，我才更要杀死他，这王八蛋把我赶出家门，还差点打断了我的狗腿，若不是孙哥，我特么连看郎中的钱都没有。”

    “嘿嘿，陆杨，我好奇问一句，你真的不能那啥了？”

    孙志刚的话，让陆杨脸色一滞。

    可孙志刚才不在意他的感受，“啧啧，说起来，你那媳妇确实不错，脸蛋儿漂亮的跟个仙女也就不说了，关键是那胸，那屁股，我草，早知道你这家伙不行，兄弟就可以帮忙啊，还劳烦孙哥干什么？”

    “孙志刚，你想抢孙哥的女人？”

    一直不说话的陆方突然发问。

    孙志刚讪笑两下，“哪敢啊，我就说说，过过嘴瘾而已，那等仙女也只有孙哥有资格享用。”

    “最好如此，不然……”

    陆方话里的意思不言自明。

    气氛一僵，几人也就不说话了，专心看着下山的路，等待着陆林。

    “原来如此。”

    陆林嘀咕一句。

    这三人上山，就是为了杀自己。

    混账陆杨，还把嫂嫂卖给了孙友成。

    陆林一死，陆杨又是一副混账样，嫂嫂的余生只能在黑暗中度过。

    陆林握紧了拳头。

    这三人该死。
content_en:
There was no reason for Sun Youcheng to hesitate.

No matter how bold he was, he didn't dare to use his brain on the court's spring tax.

Once someone finds out, it will cause the whole family to lose their heads.

Seeing his elder brother hesitate, Sun Youwen continued to increase the amount.

"Brother, I'm just one step away from this. If I can succeed, our family will be the most prominent family in Baiyang Town."

"When the time comes, you don't have to stay in this shabby village. I'll take you to the county town. There are three brothels there alone, as well as other places to eat, drink and play. I'll keep you entertained."

"Moreover, once I can enter the imperial examination, our family will be like an emperor in Baiyang Town. Even the Kong family, which is known as a century-old family, will also act based on our expressions."

"Brother, it's up to you whether you will become famous or unknown. You have to make a decision early."

I have to say.

The scenes described by Sun Youwen are very touching.

"Youwen, does dad know about this?"

"Of course I know, my father came up with this solution for me."

Sun Youwen answered extremely calmly.

But Sun Youcheng, who was lowering his head and thinking, didn't notice his brother's twinkling eyes.

"Okay!"

Sun Youcheng gritted his teeth and said, "Since dad knows, then my brother's head will be in your hands."

"Brother, there is no need to be so solemn. Everything will go smoothly tomorrow. Just wait and become the number one dandy in Baiyang Town, hahaha!"

Sun Youwen hugged his eldest brother.

The two continued to discuss some details of tomorrow's action.

How many guards should be brought, what if there are villagers accompanying him, and where Sun Youwen will ambush.

When the conversation got heated, the two brothers were very excited.

It also made Sun Youcheng forget the three people Sun Zhigang sent to the mountain.

…

It was getting dark.

The sun is in the world, casting its last rays of light.

The clouds on the horizon were reflected in a dazzling red color.

Poetry and painting came to Lu Lin's heart at this moment.

"The sunset is infinitely beautiful, but it's almost dusk."

After reciting half a poem, Lu Lin continued to set off.

When he was almost at the mountain pass, he vaguely noticed a figure moving in front of him.

Lu Dayong said that anything is possible in the mountains, but don’t rush up to say hello.

If you encounter a wild beast, the worst possible outcome is life and death.

But if you meet someone with evil thoughts, it will make life worse than death.

Lu Lin kept this in mind.

However, among the figures, there was a shadow that Lu Lin was quite familiar with, and it looked a bit like Lu Yang.

Lu Yang?

This guy had a broken leg, so why did he come to the mountains?

Lu Lin was confused.

Lu Lin put down the winter deer on his back and approached carefully with the bow on his back.

When he was still fifty steps away from these people, Lu Lin heard Lu Yang's voice.

"Damn it, I'm freezing to death. Isn't this bastard Lu Lin dead in the mountains?"

"Lu Yang, why are you so anxious? Are you so eager to kill your own brother?"

Sun Zhigang asked with a playful smile.

"Of course, it's because he is my biological brother that I want to kill him. This bastard kicked me out of the house and almost broke my dog's legs. If it weren't for Brother Sun, I wouldn't even have the money to see the doctor."

"Hey, Lu Yang, I'm curious, is there really nothing you can do?"

Sun Zhigang's words made Lu Yang's face froze.

But Sun Zhi didn't care about his feelings just now, "Tsk tsk, speaking of which, your wife is really good. She has a face as pretty as a fairy. The key is those breasts and that ass. Damn it. If I had known that you were not good, my brother could have helped. Why bother Brother Sun?"

"Sun Zhigang, do you want to steal Brother Sun's woman?"

Lu Fang, who had been silent until now, suddenly asked.

Sun Zhigang sneered twice, "How dare you? I'm just telling you that it's just a mouthful. Only Brother Sun is qualified to enjoy such fairies."

"It's best, otherwise..."

The meaning of Lu Fang's words is self-evident.

The atmosphere became tense, and the few people stopped talking and focused on looking at the road down the mountain, waiting for Lu Lin.

"That's it."

Lu Lin muttered.

These three people went up the mountain just to kill themselves.

Bastard Lu Yang even sold his sister-in-law to Sun Youcheng.

After Lu Lin died, Lu Yang looked like a bastard again, and his sister-in-law could only spend the rest of her life in darkness.

Lu Lin clenched his fists.

These three deserve to die.
